Welcome to Madagascar! Today we explore Antananarivo, the capital of Madagascar, and discover the shocking reality of everyday life in this fascinating African island country.
From crowded streets and old taxis to poverty, Indian businesses, Gujarati communities and local markets, this Madagascar travel vlog reveals a side of Africa that most tourists never see.
In this episode of Travelling Mantra, we explore Antananarivo, also known as Tana, with our Indian friends who have been living in Madagascar for many years.
